sourceCurrency.description: The currency which is used to fund a currency conversion or payout

amount.description: The amount you want to send or convert

action.description: the value can only be "send" for conversions and disbursement.

transactionType.description: If you want to make a payout, choose "disbursement," and if you want to convert a currency and receive the funds in your Fincra account, choose "conversion."

paymentDestination.description: This is the type of account you want to send your payments to

paymentScheme.description: This is the valid payment scheme for the destination currency you want to generate a quote for.This is only required when the transaction type is disbursement and not conversion
